# Path-signature-based approach to neural-operator forecasting

A concept shared by **63** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #1,881. ## Description

Proposed path-signature-based approach to neural-operator forecasting: Learn a mapping from market-state histories or feature fields to a forecast or allocation output; the predicted variable, forecast horizon, and validation protocol must be defined. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
